notes.title: Patch 1.2 is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/26458eabe920cb21936356e0162a83950fe4addc.png[/img]

Hey, Champions

After the launch on Steam part of the team finally got something none of us had in almost 3 years of development... a little break. And... Ohh... it feels good to sleep more than 5 hours a night again! Although on break we kept working on bug fixing and balance issues, posting almost daily updates and fixes in order to make the game as stable as possible.

Now we are finally ready to launch the first major update from Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess since its launch. Patch 1.2!

Coming on Saturday, November 19, this patch includes the highly requested localization options for French, German, Portuguese and Spanish; rebalancing of the whole game's rerun; new visual and sound effects, a lot of optimization and, of course, lots of bug smashing.

And don't forget that quite soon you will be able to play Grid Force on XBOX and Nintendo Switch.

Thank you for sending us a ton of feedback and awesome reviews and don't forget to join our Discord and follow us on Twitter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/ae35b15e5e8491e28bc61a19508017edf4c7daf4.jpg[/img]

[h2]You asked, we listened![/h2]

Throughout the development of Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess we had one thing everyone loved and asked for! The soundtrack!

We're happy to announce that the Grid Force digital soundtrack is now available here on steam, it contains all the amazing music heard on your journey and adventures through the world of Gora.

Get it here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090090/Grid_Force__Mask_of_the_Goddess_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090090/Grid_Force__Mask_of_the_Goddess_Soundtrack/[/url]


[h2]Composing Flows[/h2]

In Grid Force, the music is reactive. Depending where you are on a stage or event depends on music intensity and what instruments are present. In the game, it adds to the great immersion we are trying to create.

However, when it came to composing a soundtrack, Nick, who made the music for the game, suddenly needed a structure for the music to create a cohesive piece that you can sit and listen to, that perhaps may start slow and ramp up as the song progresses or the opposite, a song that cools down after time. 

Or sometimes both!

He's done an amazing job on it and we hope you enjoy it!


[h2]Tracklist[/h2]

notes.title: GRID FORCE - JUNE DEVELOPER RECAP
notes.content:
Howdy!

Welcome to this Grid Force developer recap for the month of June, 2022, and blimey, what a month it’s been. There’s lots to talk about this time, perhaps more so than ever before, and whilst some of it may be familiar territory to those of you who hang around our Discord or follow our socials, there should be some sneaky bonus bits and bobs in store, as well.

Some of the stuff I’m bringing up feels like it happened months ago, but rest assured, this is everything we got up to in the month of June. 

Let’s go.

[h1]ELEVEN-OH-EIGHT-TWENTY-TWO[/h1]

Earlier this month we announced that Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess will be dropping on the 11th of August, 2022!

It’s been a long time coming as we push on with development of the game, but we were delighted -- and slightly terrified -- to finally unveil the release date for all of you. 

And, to coincide with this, we also released the Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess - Official Trailer to give an updated peek into how the game now looks. 
[previewyoutube=w0LYxc1GQrc;full][/previewyoutube]
It’s come a long way since the days of the mobile-friendly Grid Fight, and there’s still a bit more to go, but we’re very close now. 

Not only that, but we also also released an updated demo onto Steam, Itch.io and the Xbox Store so you can have the chance to not only see the current state of Grid Force, but experience it, too.

[i](More on the new demo in the next segment.)[/i]

The final month of development is upon us! Let’s get this game finished.

[h1]TEMPLE TRIALS AND TRIBULATIONS[/h1]

On the 27th of June, we launched a BIG content update, free for all players who download the demo for Grid Force! 

We’ve dubbed this The Temple Trials (thanks, Jordan) and it serves as a survival challenge against 50 waves of increasingly difficult enemies. 

For those in search of some straight-up grid-based action, this is the place for you, and if you’re looking to grab some exclusive Grid Force merch at the same time, look no further, because anyone that enters the Temple Trials competition will be added to our prize pool for a Grid Force t-shirt, and, the victor of the Temple Trials will receive a collector’s edition Grid Force Xbox Series X|S controller. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/bb6b1c6dcf6e56e6c13271a402194bafae90c494.jpg[/img]
Fill out [url=https://forms.gle/jdcnKFmzPSHXadhB8]this Google Form[/url] to enter, and jump into the latest Grid Force demo over on Steam, Itch.io, or the Xbox Store, and smash through 50 tough-as-nails waves of enemies.

Good luck!

[i](You’re gonna need it. I’ve been getting bodied in the back half of the challenge.)[/i]

[h1]BUG OF THE MONTH: I’M YOU BUT LONGER[/h1]

The Temple Trials didn’t come without their tribulations, however, and if you were in our Discord at the time, you’d know we spent some considerable time squashing bug after bug that snuck its way into those 50-wave runs. 

Some of them were just plain annoying, like Wasper’s general existence, but there were a couple of humorous ones, too, and this month’s banger of a bug comes from Jordan, one of our QA team members.

Presenting: The Long One
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/031505e35566349bee20ab57a7eb81447c7237fb.png[/img]
For context, these critters are supposed to be the size of a single square on the grid -- similar to that Fishylla next to it -- but something went horrendously wrong causing them to be stretched up and off the screen.

Luckily, this has since been fixed and the culprit appropriately seized, so you won’t have to worry about encountering the Long One in the Temple Trials, or the final release of the game.

[i](Unless…)[/i]

[i](It genuinely won’t appear, but if it does, please let us know [b]immediately[/b] that the Long One has escaped containment.)[/i]

[h1]BUG-A-BOO[/h1]

Last up, this is a quick announcement/reminder that we have a mailing list! If you sign up, or perhaps you were signed up already, you’ll receive some exclusive giveaway opportunities, as well as early access to blog posts like this one!
[url=http://eepurl.com/gboSCv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/337145b0cc0c5a9e0d85bd69d96daa69fd78fdfb.png[/img][/url]

[h1]NOTHING MORE TO SAY[/h1]

And that, my friends, marks the end of this June developer blog post from us. It’s been a busy, busy month, and we suspect next month will be even busier, still!

Also, I have a slight confession to make, as the July developer blog post will be the final one I write here at Playtra Games. I’ve loved producing these lil’ recaps every month, and I hope that they’ll continue in some way, shape, or form moving forward. 

Until then, though, I hope you have a great month, treat each other well, and that you’ll join us over the next few weeks as we prepare to ship Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess.

Take care!

[i]- Staples [Community Manager at Playtra][/i]

notes.title: Grid Force - Official Trailer & Release Date
notes.content:
Hey there!

I’m Staples, one of the community managers and members of the marketing department at the former Playtra Games, and want to welcome you to this very special developer update. 

Not only has today’s blog post been a long time coming, but it’s got some massively important pieces of information about Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess.

So, allow me to waste no time, and jump right into it.

[h1]GRID FORCE - OFFICIAL TRAILER & RELEASE DATE[/h1]

After months of teasers and hints and, well, more teasers, I’m proud to present the official trailer for Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess, plus, the release date!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w0LYxc1GQrc]Click here to watch the trailer.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/adab1428bb800ee0208399976673ccf19518f8fe.jpg[/img]

And yes, you saw that correctly. 

[b]Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess will be released on the 11th of August, 2022.[/b]

And, if I can get serious for a moment, I am personally delighted that this trailer is finally available for your eyes and ears and whatever else you use to consume trailers. It’s been in the making for a long time, and, for those unaware, I edited this over the course of… a while, and through so many iterations and drafts that they practically reach the triple digits when you combine them all. 

Seeing it go from a crummy lil’ design document I wrote to an equally as crummy initial draft that used pantomimed emojis instead of actual footage (yes, really) to this final version has been quite the experience. 

Of course, a trailer like this can’t be made without one hell of a game to show off, and the team has done an incredible job of making Grid Force everything we believed it could and should be. I feel that’s best illustrated, right here, in the official trailer.

Plus, additional credit must go to our composer & SFX legend Nicola who provided the music for the trailer, as well as some crisp custom footage and much-needed moral support. And, our CEO and co-founder Dan, who’s a dab hand in After Effects, provided the visuals for the text on the title cards that really made the trailer pop. 

[i](If you find yourself lovin’ the trailer, please share it with everyone you can. Friends, family, pets, anyone. It’ll really help us out.)[/i]

[h1]WE’RE IN THE ENDGAME NOW[/h1]

Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess couldn’t be any closer. (Well, it could, but hush.)

Releasing on the 11th of August, you’ll finally be able to experience Grid Force in its entirety.

Remember to check out the trailer, wishlist Grid Force on Steam, take a crack at our latest demo, and mark your calendars for August 11th.

Take care, everyone!

- Staples [Community Manager at Playtra Games]

notes.title: Grid Force - May Developer Recap
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome to the Playtra Games developer update for the month of May, 2022.

We slowed down our event attendances and sped up our game development as we blast through the final months of development on Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess.

And, due to a last minute change of plans, there’s a lil’ bit more going on in this blog post than expected, which is why I’m writing this after the rest of it, and why it’s reaching you a day later than usual

(Sorry.)

We’re very close to release now, the final stretch, and next month we’ll likely have tons more material to share, too, so even though this puts May in an awkward transitional period for us, don’t fret, as there’s still a lot of stuff to share with you today, including some livestreams we’ve been doing, some spicy asset updates in Grid Force, and, most crucial of all, the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379960/Grid_Force__Mask_Of_The_Goddess/]Grid Force demo[/url].

Send it.

[h1]THE NEW DEMO[/h1]

Let’s start with the most important bits first.

Last month I mentioned that we were rolling out a new demo to Steam in the near future after getting feedback on it at both Insomnia 68 and Format. Well… it’s here, baby!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/3344af6bbbbc7a70ef3c5aa8df1e0b34b32db831.png[/img]

The team has been working hard on getting it as polished and bug-free as possible, and with the development of the main game happening simultaneously, it’s a more time-consuming task than one might think.

Even still, in case you missed our update yesterday, to coincide with our inclusion in the Dreamhack Beyond Steam event we have unveiled the latest, shiniest, brand spanking(est) new Grid Force demo for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/b3c82804edbe4344a33105c2bf2c36dd9df9c54b.png[/img]

[i](Try it out, and let us know how you got on!)[/i]

[h1]ABSOLUTE PERFECTION[/h1]

Next up, residents of our Grid Force Discord server (join the server please please please) will have seen some asset upgrades that are being worked into Grid Force as we approach our release date. 

There’s too many to show off in this post, but here's a couple of our most recent before & after snapshots to show the night and day difference between the old assets and the new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/97425b9fa9160ecdbaffb14a5a60f6b9f5e71804.png[/img]
[i]Tikaka Wooden Stake Upgrade / Pietro Brunelli - Concept Artist[/i]

And for the next one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/d1785ac0c35f149a789e8e26eee08d88b540c05e.png[/img]
[i]Tohora Graphic Rework / Pietro Brunelli - Concept Artist[/i]

If you’d like to see more of these, keep up to date with the graphical reworks as they’re made, or even ask questions to the artist directly you can do so via our Discord server.

[i](But, perhaps you’d like to see the assets whilst they’re being worked on? Well…)[/i]

[h1]SOMEBODY’S WATCHING ME[/h1]

We’ve been putting a lot of effort into building and interacting with our community as best we can over the last few months, and the next step in that plan for us has been the introduction of the PlaytraGames Twitch channel.

We’re still working out how to best utilize our livestreams so we can chat with viewers and get some work done at the same time, so, here’s a few tentative examples of what we’ve been up to. 

Level Design / Character Balancing w/ Dan
Grid Force Bug Hunting w/ The QA Team
Art Streams w/ Noemi
Asset and Visual Updates w/ Pietro
Educating Fudge!

We have something akin to a schedule, but we’re also open to streaming spontaneously, too, so if you’re interested in seeing our work in real-time as crack on with Grid Force, you know where to go.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/playtragames](Here. It’s here.)[/url]

Alongside that, occasionally we’ll be taking one of our streams, chopping it down into something more manageable, and throwing it up on our YouTube channel.

Like this one!
[previewyoutube=Qc4bSalbBNA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]BUG OF THE MONTH: EVIL PAN[/h1]

The team hates bugs.

They’re annoying, they break stuff, they take a lot of effort to root out and fix; it’s just a nightmare. Now I’m not saying that I, community & marketing gremlin at Playtra, love bugs, but what I am saying is that the bug reports are very funny to read.  

Unbelievably, this next bug was captured live by the QA team.
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/596a0fa2bebafbf177669597/67e31e83-2cda-458d-a2f6-d8e303e54aed/GIF+IMAGE+%235.gif?format=750w[/img]

For context, this segment appears early in the game, the first full stage, in fact, and comes as a result of making a certain decision wherein Pan sends out a healing orb to bring Pai back from the brink of death.

However, Pan is… well, not the best shot, apparently, so the orb just bounces around for a bit instead of striking Pai to heal her, before vanishing into thin air as unhelpfully as possible.

At the time of writing, this has been fixed, but it gave us a good laugh when it came up. 

[h1]SO I’M SAYING MY GOODBYES[/h1]

With all that being said, I’m going to wrap up this month’s blog post!

It was on the longer side than it was a few days ago, and as June is also going to be such a hectic month for us here at Playtra, there’ll be no shortage of content for the next one. In fact, I suspect it’ll blow the lid on a lot of the bits and bobs we’ve been keeping under wraps for the time being.

With an updated demo available right now, and a brand spanking new trailer coming soon, the latter edited by yours truly, we’re going to have lots to talk about next time. 

Until then, though, I hope you’ve had a great May, and I wish you all the best moving forward into June. 

Be good to each other. 

[i]- Staples [Community Manager at Playtra][/i]

notes.content:
Hey there!

You’ve read the title. [i](Hopefully).[/i]

You’ve seen the teasers. [i](Maybe).[/i]

You’re here to conquer the grid. [i](Who isn’t?)[/i]

So, we’re pleased to announce that the new demo for Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess is officially live on Steam.

Dropping you into the very start of the game, the new demo will give you the chance to experience the story from the beginning, try out the heavily reworked tutorial -- or skip it entirely if you’re a Grid Force pro -- and blast from Clea’s Temple to Tohora with optional dialogue, secret encounters, and chances to upgrade your squad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/aadc0c6c4720a25744900fcc487743debf071095.png[/img]

What to expect in the demo:
[list]
[*] Graphical updates and asset overhauls.
[*] Roaming feature implementation.
[*] Reworked tutorial.
[*] 2 stages | Clea’s Temple & Tohora
[*] Improved upgrade system.
[*] New UI.
[*] Story opening.

With our previous demo being from October 2021, we’ve been working hard over the last 8+ months to crack on with development of the game, and with us being so close to getting the full release out there, we wanted to give everyone the chance to experience how far the game has come in that time.

Plus, the previous demo had a few… unsavoury bugs, shall we say, and we wanted to put our best foot forward with this new one.

Thanks to those at Dreamhack for letting us share a space with tons of brilliant games, and, if you’re here from that event, hello! Please consider wishlisting our game as it really helps us out.

And, if you’ve been on the fence about trying Grid Force, now is the best time to give it a crack.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379960/Grid_Force__Mask_Of_The_Goddess/]Here’s that link again![/url] [i](Don’t say I never do anything for you.)[/i]

So, jump in, let us know how the game feels, and most importantly of all, conquer the grid!

Take care,

[i]- Staples [Community Manager at Playtra Games][/i]

notes.title: GRID FORCE - APRIL DEVELOPER RECAP
notes.content:
Howdy!

Welcome to another developer update for the month of April, 2022.

It’s been an exhausting yet wonderful month for us here at Playtra, and as always, there’s plenty to update you on, so much so that I’ve chosen to squeeze a lil’ TL;DR at the end of this post in case you want to skip to the cold, hard facts. 

I won’t be offended. 

[i](I might be.)[/i]

We visited some gaming events. Two, to be exact, and we’ve a plethora of content to share from those, as well as a handful of progress updates, and the game mode that could’ve been.

Let’s roll. 

[h1]COUNTING SHEEP BUT RUNNING OUT[/h1]

A handful of us here at Playtra attended the i68 Insomnia event in Birmingham on the 15th - 18th of April, and boy howdy, it was an adventure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/b1f2a0d33d8961940cf74a2061d5268958f86325.jpg[/img]
[i]Rishi & Jordan [QA Team] | Dan [CEO & Co-Founder][/i]

We got to meet many of you there and give away some event-exclusive Grid Force merch, as well as show off our newest demo that’s not currently available to the masses. Don’t worry, though, as we’re looking to push that demo out onto Steam in the coming weeks, so everyone gets to have a crack at all the new iterations Grid Force has been through since our last playable teaser. 

To get a better look at what we got up to at Insomnia, swing on over to our social media pages, such as [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playtragames/video/7086924084344261894?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7067834433184876037]this[/url] TikTok, and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playtragames/video/7087508372013976838?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7067834433184876037]this[/url] one, too. 

You can also head over to our [url=https://twitter.com/Playtra_Games]Twitter[/url], or, better yet, our [url=https://discord.com/invite/grid-force]Discord[/url], and have a peruse through our events channel.

[i](Oh, and if you were at Insomnia, give us a shout so we can find you!)[/i]

[i]((Not in a weird way.))[/i]

[h1]AIN’T NO PARTY LIKE A FORMAT PARTY[/h1]

In addition to going buck wild at Insomnia, less than a week later some of the Playtra team did the very same at [url=https://twitter.com/FormatGG]FormatGG’s[/url] gaming event in Manchester. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/633f62dbea545ab078a2cea1b14c782d441b17bd.jpg[/img]
[i]Nicola [Marketing/Community Manager & SFX] | Noemi [Comic Book & Concept Artist] | Fudge [Social Media & Community Manager][/i]

Once again, getting to meet so many gamer folks, streamers, journalists, and other content creators really was a dream come true for us. All the feedback we received during these events is invaluable to our team as we press onward with development.

To get a better look at what we got up to at FORMAT, swing on over to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/grid-force]Discord[/url], and be sure to let us know if you were there as we’d love to hear from you.

[i](You may have also gotten a sneak peak of the upcoming Grid Force trailer that I’ve been working on, but shh, don’t tell anyone.) [/i]

[h1]ASSORTED FUDGES[/h1]

It’s not often I’d dedicate a whole segment to talking about a quick social media post we made, but, with the recent addition of social media and community legend Fudge, Playtra’s newest team member, our TikTok page has had some much-needed life breathed into it, and nowhere is that better demonstrated than the #GamingSkills speedrun post, now boasting a hefty 120k views.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/ad985b8857f1e53b8e15fcbbe6c1f58879e531e4.jpg[/img]
[i]The Playtra Games TikTok Page | 29/04/2022[/i]

If you haven’t done so already, head on over to our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playtragames]TikTok[/url] page and give the video a watch.

Also, don’t forget to follow our page because, in the words of Fudge, [i]more bangers coming…[/i]

[i](Should we do another speedrun challenge soon? Hmm…)[/i]

[h1]GRID FISH - BASS OF THE GODDESS[/h1]

This one isn’t real.

April Fools is an interesting holiday. 

Sometimes you do a quick goof that deploys the dopamine and moves on, nice and easy, and sometimes you spend several hours of the only life you’ll ever have designing a game mode as a joke until nobody thinks it’s a joke anymore and your colleagues become greatly concerned. 

Anyway, here’s what a fishing minigame would look like in Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess: 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/596a0fa2bebafbf177669597/7b7f3f9f-bcd0-49eb-99ed-493603e2bd3c/ezgif.com-gif-maker.gif?format=1000w[/img]
[i]Fishing Minigame Concept | Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess | Nicola[/i]

It might be hard to tell from this gif that’s had all the pixels squeezed out of it, but you don’t just stand at the water and get a fish for free. In fact, if you try and pull a fish too soon, or too late, you’ll get nothing. But, if you nail the timing, a Physhilla could be yours.

Or it would be, if this was going in the game, which it isn’t.

Unless…

[i](I am actually legally required to say that this is not going in the game ever.)[/i]

So why am I showing you this?

Well, I think there’s a lot to glean from this regarding Grid Force, and game development in general. To make a fully-fledged fishing minigame that would feel appropriate and respectively polished in Grid Force would be a real time sink and, from a budgetary standpoint, not that viable either. But, being able to visualize our ideas is an important part of seeing what does work, what doesn’t work, and what we just don’t have the time or resources for.

It’s a shame we can’t do it, but sometimes that’s the way it is. You gotta make the tough decisions to keep the wheels in motion. Plato said that.

[i](Probably. I dunno.)[/i]

Grid Force won’t have a fishing minigame, but the systems we have in place made something like this possible, so, make sure you keep an eye out on what else our game can offer when it releases in the summer of this year.

[i](If anything, I’m just annoyed at Nicola for getting me all hyped up for a fishing minigame that we’ll never get to see.)[/i]

[h1]JUST THE TIP OF THE (ICE)BURG[/h1]

Lastly, our beloved second stage in Grid Force, ‘The Burg’, is getting a facelift.

For those unfamiliar, the Burg is the stage currently serving as the demo for Grid Force, at least, it is when this developer diary is being posted. 

That means it’s time, once again, for our traditional before and after image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/b186a561c11a029d0193ac1971e3b28ab448f2a5.png[/img]
[i]The Burg | Before & After | Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess[/i]

With a shift in the time of a day, some extra props on the side, and a cheeky bit of graffiti, the Burg is the nearest hot spot for champions wielding huge laser cannons looking to destroy giant robot teddy bears.

Like the changes? Let us know in the comments!

[h1]WITTY ENDING HEADER[/h1]

At last, with all that being said, it’s time to wrap up this month’s blog post!

Thanks for reading, and be sure to add Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess to your Steam wishlist. 

We wanted to thank everyone who has already done so, too, as it helps us out tremendously.

As for the quick notes…

TL;DR:
We went to i68 Insomnia and Format. 
We have a new community & social media team member. 
We concepted a fishing game for a laugh.
The Burg has had a visual redesign. 

Take care, everyone. See you in May!

[i]- Staples [Community Manager at Playtra][/i]

notes.title: GRID FORCE - MARCH DEVELOPER RECAP
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome to this developer update / recap for the month of March, 2022. This one will be on the shorter side compared to February’s packed blog post, but don’t worry, as we still have some neat bits and pieces to share with you today.

We had a few Grid Force livestreams that you may have caught over the last couple weeks, as well as further updates to our game as we fire full speed ahead to our release date, and some fun (frustrating) bugs that we love to share on the side.

Let’s get to it.

[h1]IT GETS BETTER[/h1]

We collaborated with the It Gets Better Project once again to dedicate a day to streaming Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess on Twitch, and we had a great time doing so.

First up, on the official It Gets Better Twitch channel, JM from [url=https://www.twitch.tv/2gays1twitch]2Gays1Twitch [/url] played through the demo of Grid Force and was joined by Playtra’s very own co-founder & game director Dan, concept & comic book artist Noemi, and composer, marketing, & community manager Nicola.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/2da9c9475aec5e16fd0521c7e438c590565f957c.png[/img]

Together, we gave away some CORSAIR goodies, an AMD Ryzen 5, and a copy of Grid Force, to boot.

The VOD can be found [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1428411215?collection=mAZzdapHzRbUOg]here[/url].

On top of that, two other streamers, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/risshella]Risshella[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mivyard]Mivyard[/url], also gave Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess a go on their streams, as well, both doing an amazing job mastering the mechanics and showing off the game to their lovely audience.

[i](Plus, we love seeing people play our game, so, if you’re a streamer or a gaming YouTuber who’s interested in Grid Force, please feel free to reach out to us so we can share your work!)[/i] 

[h1]SINGLE FILE, PLEASE[/h1]

Something broke again.

Our QA Team are always hard at work breaking Grid Force as best as they can, and this sometimes leads to bugs that we just have to share with you all, such as this one, where the entire roster can’t decide who should fight Mama Bear first.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/596a0fa2bebafbf177669597/db6e4702-5e0b-4cc3-9ca4-92415e999548/ezgif.com-gif-maker.gif?format=750w[/img]

Needless to say, this won’t be carried over into the live game, despite how amusing it is every single time it happens. 

[i](It’s the way Donna says “What was that?” whilst the universe crumbles around her that really sends me.)[/i]

[h1]CONDITIONAL FORMATTING[/h1]

As somewhat of a spillover from last month, the FORMAT Event in Manchester is fast approaching, and at the time of this post going live, we are a mere three weeks away from hopefully seeing many of you there!

For those interested, tickets are still available, and you can use the discount code FORMAT_AP25 to get 25% off your order in time for April 21st.

Those in attendance can stop by to check out Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess, and enter our giveaway to be in with a chance of winning some CORSAIR peripherals and some other cheeky, Grid Force-related prizes. Swing by for a shot at those, play some great games, and chat with the developers, too. 

Further details can be found [url=https://www.fatsoma.com/e/ediv81ll/format-manchester-the-ultimate-gaming-social-2022-launch-party?utm_campaign=prom_ss&utm_medium=social&utm_source=dynamic]here[/url], and we hope to see you soon!

(We’ll touch more on the experience of FORMAT next month once we return, so keep an eye out for the April update dropping in… well… April.)

[h1]ADORE & LAUGHTER FOR OUR BEFORE & AFTER[/h1]

We’re continuing with something we occasionally like to do over on our [url=https://twitter.com/Playtra_Games]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/grid-force]Discord[/url] (pluggo pluggo, click the links) wherein we show something in the early stages of development, and then jump over to how it looks now to get a nice comparison and see how far it’s come.

Today, we have some spooky scary skellies to show you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/1b382bbd313b850c3cd0266d9a6f1b5777a77f8a.png[/img]

Now with stained teeth, smoother edges, and deeper, sunken eyes infested with greenery, this skull is perhaps more alive than ever. 

For a closer look at these images, head on over to [url=https://twitter.com/Playtra_Games/status/1507658620392988673]this post[/url] for a video breakdown of the changes made, and hit us with your thoughts down in the comments. 

[h1]FULL STEAM AHEAD[/h1]

To wrap this post up, we revamped some aspects of our Steam store page to see how we can best make use of it. If you’re reading this, there’s a chance you’re there right now, but, either way, have some screenshots for your convenience!

Here’s the capsule image comparison:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/4a3fcdbb1695baf73bf04d6bafdae62d4a3a5bcb.png[/img]

And that’s everything for this month!

Be sure to wishlist Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess on Steam if you haven’t done so already, as with the [b]Q2 2022[/b] release date getting closer every day, we’ll have more announcements to make in the coming months. But, until then, thanks for stopping by, and we’ll be back with more updates next month.

notes.title: Happy Holidays by Playtra's Team - It's been an amazing year together!
notes.content:
[h2]2021 with Grid Force - Mask Of The Goddess[/h2]

Hello Grid Forcers

We are at the end of this year, and before taking a few days trying to relax by playing some video games, I would love to look back at this year and see with you what was done. Also, how about a sneak peek at what is to come? Well, continue reading then...

[h3]From Grid Fight to Grid Force[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/96afac6678e14801241dab3d062bcc8b596a0ea9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/9241430e8121dcc52f8d273728c78c53903994d4.jpg[/img]

First of all, this is the year we went from "Grid Fight" to "Grid Force - Mask Of The Goddess", and I have the feeling we never explained why of this decision.

The reason is... well... because you know... "Force" sounds cooler than "Fight" I guess? No for real, while the game has fights and wars at its core, we wanted the title to also tell a bit of the story. The "grids" are not only random places where you fight enemies but are also divine areas, designated to achieve your destiny. Grids have rules that need to be followed, in order to stop the reboot of Gora.

How about "Mask Of The Goddess" then? That's because the masks are powerful artifacts that can literally change the destiny of the world. Not only they are strong tools to use in the fights, but they are also a key element in the story. Donna will have to conquer them all if she wants to have a chance to save her newly-found family.

[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/ee2aac5406a62aab3d98a7b83a1e77dc1b95c0bd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/f00fa676f1d59d5108ae713512986f3455167a46.gif[/img]

We wanted to spice up gameplay by adding new mechanics. Following the mantra "easy to pick up, hard to master" we made sure that the game was enjoyable at any level. Skilled players can now stagger easily by frame-parring and shooting at the right time. While beginners can still win fights by unleashing a hell of bullets (break the spacebar!) Overall, the gameplay evolved a lot and finally reflects the vision we had when we started the development back in 2019.

[h3]New UI[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/881fcf325c9d406a754d61949117151f6d8421ef.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/42fbc3ee4baded4c9bbd14998b9c4e71161d7110.gif[/img]

Ok, you have no idea how many iterations with did on the UI. And we are pretty pleased with the latest results. It looks like it's able to give all the right information without being too overwhelming. So *pat pat* to us. But if you disagree, let us know.

[h3]Improved Art[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/76e827ac07a213df396098793a5b6b171d539d51.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/98e824375c7ed785531b46cbe2188d7e6a70c4fa.gif[/img]

How about some cool art? This year we stepped up our game on arts and concept, plus the comics are becoming even more mind-boggling. Cannot wait to show you more next year. Speaking of which...

[h3]What is Coming on Grid Force in 2022?[/h3]

Actually, Grid Force is coming in 2022! So you can expect a release date followed by an official announcement. But that's not all. We have just finished showcasing the at the id@Xbox demo event during the TGA Awards, announcing the game to be released on the Xbox console too, and, more consoles announcements are coming soon next year!

We are also working on a new mechanic that will give some breather between battles, in which the player can freely move around the conquered grid and decide whether to start a conversation or to jump directly to the next fight. This will give more control to you, the player, to decide the pacing of the game.

Finally, we will have more showcases and events getting closer to the release date. So 2022 it's going to be incredible and I hope you will be with us on this journey!

Happy Holidays everyone.

Always, may the goddess be with you!

notes.title: What a demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/0ca238d0d2ee22ca793d9a66b5cf92a78929507b.jpg[/img]Here 

we are! Today we are announcing our latest, and possibly last update for the demo of Grid Force - Mask Of The Goddess.

[h2]Short and sweet[/h2]
In this demo, you will play the second mission, in the town of The Burg, a city slowly falling into chaos. There, your party will get caught in the war between the rebel group called FIX and their arch-enemies, the shady NORM corporation. You will make new friends and enemies, and unravel the mysteries kept in the shadows by Mainframe, Burg's Machinae.

[h2]Play and Replay[/h2]
Did you manage to finish the mission? Try playing again. The Burg will remember your decisions and open up new paths and storylines. In each playthrough, you may find new mysteries and secrets. Maybe try playing again with different members in your squad. You never know what they can unlock ;-)

And don’t forget to upgrade your current and new characters to unlock great new abilities. Didn’t manage to recruit all the characters? Well, then you still have some secrets to solve!

[h2]Stagger, Elementals and More[/h2]
We added so many new mechanics that will make your game much more dynamic and strategic, Starting with the STAGGER SYSTEM. Who doesn’t like staggering enemies? Because we freaking love it! Use your quick attacks to raise the stagger bar of your enemy, when it hits the mark, the enemy will enter a staggering state that can last a few seconds, that’s the perfect moment to blast all your artillery against them.

But there’s a better way to be even more efficient, check the element sign of your character and compare it with one of your enemies. Light, Dark, Water, Fire, Air and Earth, each especially efficient against another.  If your element is stronger, then you are up for some serious damage!


[h2]We want to hear YOUR opinion[/h2]
Thank you for playing the demo and taking the time to read this. Before you go we have one favour to ask you. We want to hear your opinion and the best way to do it is by talking directly to us. [url=www.discord.com/invite/grid-force]Join our discord server[/url] and check the #suggestions channel to share any feedback, bugs, concerns or compliments (we need those!) with the team.

Always, may the goddess be with you!

notes.title: Announcing Our Partnership with the It Gets Better Project
notes.content:
[h3]We are proud to announce that we are partnering with the [b]It Gets Better Project[/b] as part of the launch for Grid Force - Mask of the Goddess.[/h3]

We know that an indie game partnering with a charity while their game is still in development is a bit unusual, but we think this is an important step for indies to take. Games have a real impact on the lives of players. For the members on our team, we all have memories of making friends and finding support through the games we play, whether that’s passing a controller back and forth on the couch, swapping fan theories in a forum, or--as it is today--hanging out in Discord.

The old adage indies always hear is to “make the game you want to play.” What does that look like if you’re black and gay? What does that look like if you’re a woman in an industry with a long history of selling games with sex appeal over character depth? For us, it looks like Grid Force.

Representation in games matters because for many kids, playing a video game is their only way to get beyond their immediate bubble. The world is changing, but many LGBTQ+ children and young adults, still feel alone and isolated.

But you’re not alone. You might not be in the best situation right now, but you can join communities online or play games to hear stories like your own. The It Gets Better Project has been sharing this message for years, and we’re excited to get to be a part of that mission with our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/86e545af651f054721bddf573e10ac7841003c65.png[/img]

We are kicking off this initiative with a Beta Showcase this weekend, live on Twitch and on Steam. For Steam, you can tune in over the weekend to meet our team members and see what we’re working on. For Twitch, we reached out to streamers who have championed inclusivity with their streams and invited them to give their communities a sneak peek of Grid Force.

Tune in and give these kinds of streamers your support ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Grid%20Force%20-%20Mask%20Of%20The%20Goddess]check the Grid Force category on Twitch[/url] Friday through Sunday).

If you’re not familiar with the It Gets Better Project, [url=https://itgetsbetter.org/]visit their website[/url] to learn more about their work, their programs, and their impact.

Thank you for being on this journey with us!

notes.title: Grid Fight - Mask Of The Goddess 🍁 Steam Game Festival Update
notes.content:
[h1]Can you save this world before it reboots?
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38471925/f11df9f1ce7816248229c19e32cc6a351d056d67.png[/img]

Grid Fight is a frantic action tactical game in the style of Mega Man Battle network with beautifully hand-drawn graphics and earworm soundtrack. 

The world has been rebooted, once again, by the Goddess Clea who chose Donna as her champion. Donna will lead a small group of heroines on her journey through the 9 cities of Gora, where she will meet her inhabitants, some will be willing to help, some others will be harder to convince.

Play the first hour of the game where you are introduced to the world of Gora, get to know your companions for this journey and face the first mad goddess. Plus, test your reflexes in a challenge level and see how far you can go.

In the first mission, you will find a real challenge, but don't worry there 8 of the 40 main characters to choose from, each with a different gameplay style. Create your favourite crew and start your mission.

Which kind of player are you? Are you interested in hearing the stories of Gora? We got you covered, your friends will tell you everything they know, you just have to ask. Are you not interested in the story? No issues, go on a rampage like a mindless drone and destroy everything that moves. But be careful, your choices may have consequences...

A stylish 2d world, upbeat music, powerful guns. Welcome to Grid Fight - Mask Of The Goddess!

Did you enjoy the demo? [url=https://discord.com/invite/grid-fight]Join the discord channel[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Playtra_Games]follow us on Twitter[/url] for some dope prizes.
